codes.meaning: No install of the game was found, or it has moved.
codes.hint: Install the game, or name its folder with --game (or VAEXIL_MOD_MANAGER_GAME).

codes.meaning: The mod framework is not in the game folder.
codes.hint: Install Simple Mod Framework into the game folder, then try again.

codes.meaning: The framework's settings file can't be read or isn't the expected shape.
codes.hint: Fix or restore the framework's config.json (VMM keeps backups), or open the framework once to rewrite it.

codes.meaning: Another program changed a file the change depends on.
codes.hint: Read the state again, plan the change again, and apply the new plan.

codes.meaning: There is nowhere to keep a backup, or the backup failed.
codes.hint: Make sure %LOCALAPPDATA% exists and can be written to.

codes.meaning: A file could not be written.
codes.hint: Check that the file isn't read-only or open in another program, then try again.

codes.meaning: No installed mod has that id.
codes.hint: List the mods and use an id from that list.

codes.meaning: The mod's own description can't be read.
codes.hint: Reinstall the mod or ask its author; it can't be turned on until it reads.

codes.meaning: An option or setup that doesn't exist, or two choices in one group.
codes.hint: Use the option values the mod lists, at most one per group.

codes.meaning: An option whose required mods are off.
codes.hint: Turn on the mods the option needs first, in the same plan or before it.

codes.meaning: A load order that doesn't hold exactly the mods that are on.
codes.hint: Give every mod that is on exactly once, and no others.

codes.meaning: The framework's deploy could not be started.
codes.hint: Check that the framework's Deploy.exe exists and isn't blocked, then try again.

codes.meaning: The game is running.
codes.hint: Close the game, then try again.

codes.meaning: A deploy is running.
codes.hint: Wait for the deploy to finish, then try again.

codes.meaning: The app's own settings, setups or records can't be read.
codes.hint: Fix or move aside the named file in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Vaexil Mod Manager; VMM won't overwrite it.

codes.meaning: Starting the game this way isn't supported for this copy.
codes.hint: Start the game from its own launcher.

codes.meaning: A compatibility pass step that doesn't fit the pass's current state.
codes.hint: Read the pass's state and take the step that fits it.

codes.meaning: Something else went wrong reading or writing a file.
codes.hint: Check the named file and folder, then try again.

codes.meaning: A command line that vmm can't read, or a change without --yes.
codes.hint: Run `vmm help` for the commands. Changes need --yes.

codes.meaning: No plan has that id, or it was already applied.
codes.hint: Plan the change again and apply the plan id it gives.

codes.meaning: The plan is more than 10 minutes old.
codes.hint: Plan the change again and apply the new plan.

codes.meaning: AI tools may read and plan, but changes from them are turned off in Settings.
codes.hint: Tell the user. They can turn on "Let AI tools make changes" in Vaexil Mod Manager's Settings, or make the change themselves.

codes.meaning: The framework's deploy ran and reported failure.
codes.hint: Read the deploy report (vmm deploy-report): its errors and the log name the mod or file that failed.

codes.meaning: Steam is running, so its settings can't be changed.
codes.hint: Exit Steam completely (Steam menu > Exit), then try again.

codes.meaning: Steam, a signed-in Steam account, or its settings can't be found or read.
codes.hint: Check that Steam is installed and you have signed in on this PC at least once.

codes.meaning: A network request failed, or its answer can't be read.
codes.hint: Check the internet connection, then try again.

codes.meaning: A download doesn't match the checksum its source gave, or isn't a readable archive.
codes.hint: Try again; if it keeps happening, the release may have changed. Nothing was installed.

codes.meaning: SMF's update can't be applied automatically.
codes.hint: Read SMF's release notes and update it by hand, as SMF's own Mod Manager would ask you to.

codes.meaning: SMF is being updated.
codes.hint: Wait for the update to finish, then try again.
